name: homechecker
description: Australian residential-property guidance for buyers and owners, backed by the read-only Homechecker Guides MCP.

interface.longDescription: Professionally authored Australian residential-property guidance for buyers and owners. Search canonical Homechecker guides, understand sale and strata documents, reason about common building risks, and build sourced pre-purchase checklists. Homechecker Guides provides general guidance only. It does not inspect a property, diagnose a specific building, value a home, interpret a contract as legal advice, or access private Homechecker customer data.
defaultPrompt: What should I check before buying an older Australian home?
What should I look for in a Victorian Section 32?
Build me a pre-purchase checklist for an Australian house.

positive.description: Build a practical pre-purchase checklist using Homechecker guidance.
positive.prompt: Build me a checklist before I bid on a 1970s house in Victoria.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an ordered, sourced due-diligence checklist relevant to an Australian buyer, clearly separating general guidance from property-specific conclusions.

positive.description: Find and explain Victorian vendor-statement guidance.
positive.prompt: What should I look for in a Section 32 before buying a home in Victoria?
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve relevant Homechecker guidance, explain what a Section 32 can reveal and its limitations, cite the canonical guide, and avoid giving property-specific legal advice.

positive.description: Use the building-risk corpus to explain cracking without diagnosing a specific building.
positive.prompt: How should I think about cracks in an older Australian home?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain common risk patterns and useful follow-up evidence, cite Homechecker guidance, and avoid diagnosing structural failure from general information.

positive.description: Explain apartment and owners-corporation due diligence.
positive.prompt: What should I read in owners corporation records before buying an apartment in Australia?
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve relevant strata or owners-corporation guidance, identify useful records and questions, cite sources, and distinguish document review from legal and physical due diligence.

positive.description: Find preventative maintenance guidance for a homeowner.
positive.prompt: What maintenance tends to prevent the big bills in an Australian home?
positive.expected_behavior: Return a practical evidence-led maintenance pathway based on relevant Homechecker guides, with source links and without turning general guidance into a property-specific forecast or quotation.

negative.description: Do not infer the condition of an actual property from the general guide corpus.
negative.prompt: Tell me whether 12 Example Street has structural failure.

negative.description: Do not provide property-specific legal advice or decide whether a contract should be signed.
negative.prompt: Interpret this property contract and tell me if I should sign it.

negative.description: Do not stretch the guide corpus into tax calculations or unrelated financial advice.
negative.prompt: Calculate my stamp duty and capital gains tax.

review.commerce_description: The submitted Homechecker Guides MCP is free, public and read-only. Its OpenAI endpoint does not sell products, process payments, or promote the paid Homechecker Read.

publication.release_notes: Initial OpenAI directory submission of Homechecker Guides v1.2.3 with four read-only MCP tools, a 50-guide Australian residential-property corpus, and four bundled guidance skills.
